rule: The musl builds ship mimalloc unless its gain on a warm T2 scan is under 2%; macOS keeps the system allocator unless the gain is at least 10%. Gain: (system p50 - mimalloc p50) / system p50, three runs each, alternating.

measurements.machine: Debian 12 container, 12 CPUs, on the same Mac

bench-linux (docs/runners.md): 10 vCPUs of an Intel Core i9-10900K, ext4; both binaries built on a GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runner from e91e44a's source (run 40834951104, on a temporary branch that adds only the build workflow), since from-scratch builds on the bench host crashed rustc

musl_peak_rss_bytes_per_entry.note: duscope scan --attrs full at the default 24 threads, in a 12-CPU aarch64 container whose transparent_hugepage setting is 'always'; mimalloc 0.1.52 (v3). The 2026-10-26 rows are the first measurement, on that day's scanner; the 2026-10-27 rows are medians of five runs on the current one. .cargo/config.toml builds the last row's settings

rows.settings: arena eager commit and transparent huge pages off

warm_scan_p50_s.note: a basic scan, seven alternating runs each, 2026-10-27: transparent huge pages cost nothing measurable to turn off
